remarks: Build your country dream on approximately 5 beautiful acres offering extensive road frontage, scenic views and plenty of possibilities! With approximately 705 feet of frontage on Beech Tree Rd and an additional 390 feet on Gooseneck Rd, this mostly open parcel offers a unique layout with excellent access and flexibility. Take in the beautiful, far reaching countryside views while enjoying an appealing combination of open land and trees along portions of the borders for added privacy and character. The acreage offers great potential for a future homesite, subject to municipal approvals and buyer's intended use, with plenty of room for a home, garage, gardens and more. Enjoy the peaceful rural setting and space to create the property you've been looking for.  An adjoining home with approximately 5 acres is also available separately ML R1714946, or purchase the entire property with approximately 10 acres and extensive frontage on both Beech Tree Rd and Gooseneck Rd at ML R1714922. See additional listings for purchase options.
